title: Container layout
description: How the board arranges one container, as structure only (no pixel sizes): the mode and card widths in effect, each card's column and row (and lane in `lanes` mode), how many of its links cross another link and how many cells are empty. Worked out by the layout package from the container's cards, links and mode.

board.description: The board the container is on.

mode.description: The mode the board shows: the person's choice when they made one, else the container's.

widths.description: The card widths in effect: the person's choice, else the container's, else the mode's default.

lanes.description: The lane names, top to bottom, in `lanes` mode; left out in every other mode.

columns.description: How many columns the container uses (0 when it holds no card); in `radial` mode, how many rings, the centre being the first.

cards.description: Every card in the container now (the person's moves count; retired cards are left out), in card-number order.

links.description: How many links join two cards in this container.

crossing.description: How many of those links cross at least one other link. 0 is the aim.

empty.description: How many cells hold no card. A cell is a column and row (in `lanes` mode, a lane and column, its cards stacked inside); within the columns and rows the container uses. Always 0 in `radial` mode.

lane.description: The lane the card is in, in `lanes` mode.

column.description: The card's column, from 1 at the left; in `radial` mode, its ring, 1 being the centre.

row.description: The card's row, from 1 at the top; in `lanes` mode, its place in its lane's stack in that column; in `radial` mode, its place around the ring.
